analysis.company_profile: HelloFresh is a global digital‑native FMCG company and the world’s leading meal‑kit provider, delivering personalized recipe boxes and ready‑to‑eat meals to millions of households across multiple brands.

candidate_positioning: A senior AI/ML engineer with 8+ years of end‑to‑end production ML experience, strong MLOps, LLM‑driven retrieval, and proven architectural leadership, positioned to lead and scale HelloFresh’s menu personalization stack.

team_needs.need: Set technical direction & architecture for end‑to‑end ML stack
team_needs.evidence: Optum: LangGraph analytics system; Viavi: SLA breach prediction platform with FastAPI, MLflow, Kubernetes; cross‑encoder retrieval model
team_needs.gap: No prior large‑scale recommender architecture; no experience with Go or Kafka

team_needs.need: Build and operate production ML systems (feature pipelines, training, serving, observability)
team_needs.evidence: Viavi: production SLA breach prediction (FastAPI, MLflow); Optum: automated evaluation & observability pipelines; Data Engineer role: PySpark pipelines, Elasticsearch/Kibana observability; Kubernetes/Docker deployment
team_needs.gap: Limited exposure to high‑throughput serving at consumer scale; no Go experience

team_needs.need: Experience with recommender systems / large‑scale personalization
team_needs.evidence: Viavi: RAG‑based Project Discovery Assistant; Optum: cross‑encoder for dense retrieval; built semantic clustering with SBERT
team_needs.gap: No explicit consumer‑facing recommender system or personalization product

team_needs.need: Statistical literacy & experiment design (A/B testing, honest metrics)
team_needs.evidence: Optum: automated evaluation pipelines with quality metrics; Viavi: model performance monitoring
team_needs.gap: No documented A/B test framework or product‑level experiment platform

team_needs.need: Hands‑on AI tooling (Claude, Copilot, etc.) daily
team_needs.evidence: Optum: Claude Opus integration; multiple LangGraph/LangChain projects

team_needs.need: Technical leadership, mentorship, and cross‑functional influence
team_needs.evidence: Led 30+ AI prototypes at Viavi; built platform components; architecture decisions for analytics and SLA systems
team_needs.gap: No explicit record of leading large cross‑functional engineering teams

project.name: Hybrid Retrieval‑to‑Ranking Recipe Recommendation Engine
project.problem: Personalize the weekly recipe list for millions of HelloFresh customers with low latency, high relevance, and measurable business impact.
project.approach: Create Spark‑based feature pipelines that ingest user interaction logs and recipe metadata; train a cross‑encoder re‑ranking model using SBERT embeddings; serve candidates via a FastAPI + MLflow endpoint on Kubernetes; stream real‑time events through Kafka; use Claude‑driven prompts for dynamic feature generation and fallback explanations; implement observability with Elasticsearch/Kibana and automated A/B testing harness; continuously iterate via online experiments.

requirements_not_covered: Direct production experience with recommender systems or large‑scale personalization
Documented large‑scale consumer‑facing deployment (millions of users)
Explicit A/B testing framework for product experiments
